text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp. 
Mejiro Dober's training was proceeding smoothly according to plan.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, which festival stalls are we hitting up first? 
I definitely want a candy apple!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
We can't miss out on the grilled carrots either! 
I wish it was nighttime already～.

With the summer festival happening tonight, 
everyone seemed noticeably more hyped up than usual during practice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
……You've been staring at me for a while now. 
Is something wrong? Do I have sand on my face or something?
choice_data_list: No……you just seem like your normal self

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't this just normal for me? Rather than worrying about that, make sure 
you're properly timing my shuttle runs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm just my usual self though……? Anyway, next is 
the shuttle runs, right? Can you time me?

A few hours after training wrapped up. The 
dormitory was unusually peaceful. Most of the girls 
had likely already headed out to the summer festival.

A few hours after training wrapped up. The 
dormitory was unusually peaceful. Most of the girls 
had likely already headed out to the summer festival.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer? You're still around?
choice_data_list: You're not going to the festival?
You're not going to the festival?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I have some things I need to take care of. 
Besides, it's way easier to concentrate when nobody else is around.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …………Hey, Trainer. Do you know how to draw backgrounds?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well…… you see, I'm working on a 『Veggie Carolyn』 
picture book based on the movie.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah-, sorry. Kind of a weird thing to ask out 
of nowhere, huh? You see…… I'm putting together a picture 
book adaptation of the 『Veggie Carolyn』 movie.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My little brother and sister…… it sounds like they couldn't go to the 
theater. Probably because they're still too young to 
sit quietly through the whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My little brother and sister…… it sounds like they couldn't go to the 
theater. Probably because they're still too young to 
sit quietly through the whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's why I wanted to make a picture book of the 
story for them…… That way they can enjoy it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I managed to finish drawing the characters, but…… there are just so 
many backgrounds. Just doing a single one takes an 
eternity, honestly……

That made sense; the movie took place on a deserted island, 
featuring all kinds of scenery. Sandy beaches, dense forests, an 
abandoned villa, and more――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh, photos……? What do you mean by that?

We're right by the beach right now. There's a forest nearby too. On top 
of that, this lodge kind of resembles a villa. In other words, it 
has every single setting from the movie.

In that case, she could cut out her character drawings 
and photograph them against real backdrops. I suggested that doing 
it this way might make finishing it much faster.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ……………………Are you sure you're really my Trainer? That's actually a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer, that's a really great idea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I print the photos out on larger paper 
and paste the cutouts onto them…… it 
would definitely look just like a real picture book!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
If I print the photos out on larger paper 
and paste the cutouts onto them…… it 
would definitely look just like a real picture book!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Then all I need to do is cut out the characters, and take the photos on the beach―― I wonder if I can wrap it all up before everyone gets back?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ……I had a feeling you'd offer to help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I figured you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even if I tried to turn you down, you're not the type to back off anyway. 
I guess I'm finally starting to get a read on you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you told me before that if I was ever having 
trouble, I should come talk to you, right? So…… 
I was planning on asking you anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's meet up in the lobby in five minutes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's meet up in the lobby in five minutes.

And so, after carefully cutting out each character illustration―― 
we moved on to the photography phase.

we moved on to the photography phase.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, a bit more to the right! Stretch your arms out as far as you 
can! Otherwise you're gonna end up in the frame too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? Is there something by the window…… Oh, that's perfect! We can 
place the characters behind the glass! It'll look like we're looking at them 
from outside the room!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I want the running scene to feel a bit more dynamic. 
Trainer, could you dash across for a second?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wait, you're gonna leave it like that? Hehe... that's kind of mysterious, actually! Hunting for the characters in the backgrounds sounds pretty fun. Thanks for the idea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll snap a picture of the beach during the day tomorrow. For now, this'll be the last one tonight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'll snap a picture of the beach during the day tomorrow. For now, this'll be the last one tonight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Don't move, Trainer. Three, two, one――

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All right, got it!
(Whistle... Bang! Ka-boom!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Fireworks...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The festival... is probably wrapping up around now...
choice_data_list: Do you want to head over now?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The stalls are probably packing up by now, right? Besides, I already asked Ryan and the others to grab some souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ――Still, festivals, huh... I used to go to them with Ryan and the others all the time back then.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Uwaah... there are so many people... Ryan, don't let go of my hand... promise you won't.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text: Ah... cotton candy. Ryan, look, cotton candy! Over there, see? Come on, let's go get some cotton candy, please?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'd cling to Ryan's hand the whole time. Begging that I wanted to do this, or eat that, dragging her all over the place...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: My mother was always so busy with work. Because of that, when I was little, I spent most of my time playing with everyone at the Mejiro estate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan took care of me so much... When I was with her, I always felt safe, and everything was just so fun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That's why when I got a little brother and sister of my own... I thought it was my turn to be a proper big sister.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All the things she did for me that made me so happy... I wanted to do the exact same things for them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Though... so far I haven't really been able to do much. Living in the dorms means I don't get many chances to visit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And whenever I do see them... I don't really know how I'm supposed to act around them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But just recently, when they happened to catch me drawing "Veggie Carolyn," they started begging me to draw more.
choice_data_list: So that's why you were practicing
So that's why you were practicing

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Drawing is pretty much the only thing I'm decent at... so I wondered if I could make something for them... and well, here we are.
choice_data_list: So you thought of a storybook
So you thought of a storybook

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Palmer always had a picture book on her. Hehe... even now, it feels like I'm always leaning on my older sisters.
choice_data_list: You look like an older sister now

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? I... look like an older sister? What do you mean by that...? Trainer, you're just flattering me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I... look like an older sister...? I really can't tell, but... do you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I still don't feel like much of a big sister. But if they end up enjoying this picture book... then maybe, just a little bit...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I still don't feel like much of a big sister... But if they end up enjoying this picture book, then... maybe I can finally start seeing myself that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Anyway, thank you so much for helping me out! Once I get back from reading it to them... I suppose I'll let you know how it went.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You really helped me out with so much, Trainer! Once I get back from showing it to them... I'll be sure to tell you all about it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All right, we should probably head back soon. The fireworks are about to finish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All right, we should probably head back soon. The fireworks are about to finish.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Once those two get a little older... I want to take them to a festival together, too...
Gazing up at the fireworks while reminiscing about her younger siblings, Mejiro Dober wore a gentle, tender smile.
